title: Route session friction to its owner and track the Core l9-ci revision
objective: Stop the post-publish Stop hooks from committing end-session handoff reports onto PR head branches, deliver governance (environment-friction) handoffs to a deduplicated Cursor-Governance intake keyed by friction id, and make the l9-ci CI-parity tool install the SDK revision that l9-ci-core org-ci.yml runs instead of a hand pin.
success_criteria: S1: publishing a session or governance end-session handoff never creates a commit, never pushes, and never changes the PR head (proved by V1 against a real git clone with a bare origin)

S2: the session handoff is upserted as exactly one PR comment per (PR, kind) keyed by <!-- l9-handoff:<kind>:<owner/repo>#<n> -->, and a second publication of the same PR edits that comment instead of adding one (proved by V2)

S3: each governance friction item is delivered to one Cursor-Governance intake issue per normalized friction id, a repeat from the same session adds no comment, and an unreachable intake falls back to the PR comment and is announced (proved by V2)
S4: GMP report publication keeps its existing commit path unchanged (proved by V1)
S5: install.py installs l9-ci at the 40-hex sdk-revision extracted from Core's org-ci.yml, records source ci_ref in state.json, and reinstalls when Core moves (proved by V3)
S6: when Core is unreadable the hand pin is installed with a WARN line, and manifest.load overlays a recorded tracked version so resolve() and run.py agree (proved by V3)
S7: validate_manifest --remote passes a tracked tool whose extract matches Core even when the hand pin differs, and fails when the extract no longer matches (proved by V3 and V4)
S8: the touched suites and the repository gate pass (proved by V5 and V6)

todos.task: Create ops/reports/handoff_delivery.py: a GitHub REST transport over `gh api` (injectable for tests, never raises), upsert_pr_comment(repo, number, marker, body) keyed by an HTML marker, deliver_friction(items, occurrence) that finds or creates one open intake issue per normalized friction id by body marker in the intake repository (session_debt.GOVERNANCE_REPOSITORY, overridable by L9_FRICTION_INTAKE_REPO) and adds one occurrence comment per session, and local_copy_path(root, kind, filename) under the git dir. Transport failures (gh absent, non-2xx, timeout per call = GIT_TIMEOUT_S, pagination capped at 10 pages) return a failed result with the reason and never raise. The PR-comment marker is <!-- l9-handoff:<kind>:<owner/repo>#<n> --> so session and governance comments never match each other or a human comment. Outside a git work tree the local copy goes to <root>/.l9/reports/end-session/<kind>/. The intake repository identity is read from ops.autonomy.session_debt.GOVERNANCE_REPOSITORY (single owner) with L9_FRICTION_INTAKE_REPO as the only override
